searchText: Is there a ZK construct that can easily recover an Ethereum address from an ECDSA signature that results in a proof that is easy to verify on Ethereum? why not just `ecrecover`? I need to prove ownership of an address that meets some requirement (e.g., has X ETH balance) without leaking any details about the address. I can create a merkle proof of the balance and verify that in a ZK proof, but I'm not sure if I can do an ECDSA recovery in a merkle proof. More specifically, I'm not sure I can do it easily/quickly. yeah the EC ops may be expensive inside a snark https://github.com/0xPARC/circom-ecdsa
